field_audit.minute_returns: close-to-prior-minute close through completed decision bar only
field_audit.realized_variance: cumulative squared minute returns with complete-path requirement
field_audit.semivariance: upside and downside realized variance through decision time
field_audit.jump_concentration: largest observed absolute minute return divided by realized volatility

economic_hypothesis: The shape and asymmetry of realized intraday volatility distinguish broad, smoothly accepted information from isolated jumps and temporary noise; positive-semivariance and volatility-acceleration states may predict the next 5-30 minutes beyond raw returns.

hard_gates.native_factory_null: run only after all pre-null gates
